_comment: Image registry. Every image used in content is listed here before it can be referenced. 'licence' is mandatory and drives attribution rendering — CC-BY and CC-BY-SA legally require credit, and the app renders it automatically from these fields so nobody has to remember. 'origin' records how the asset came to exist: photo | svg | generated. Generated images may only be used as illustration, never for identification, PPE, tools, defects or procedure. See docs/image-needs.md.
